healthRecords.title: Health Records & DNA
healthRecords.body: In Cabinet → Health Records & DNA you can upload or scan labs, imaging, DNA report PDFs, and raw DNA files (PDF, images, CSV, TXT, VCF). On mobile you can capture a printed page with the camera. Files move from Received to In review to Insights ready. Insights explain the record, list conclusions and recommendations, and stay educational — not a diagnosis. You can Copy, Print, or Download TXT any ready insight, or ask Health Guide about the selected record by text or voice. Counts and a DNA-on-file flag feed personal context for reports and Health Guide; raw DNA content is never pasted into AI prompts.

devices.title: Connected Devices
devices.body: Cabinet → Connected Devices covers seven categories: smartwatches (Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, Garmin, Google Pixel Watch, Fitbit, Polar), smart rings (Oura Ring, Ultrahuman Ring), recovery bands (WHOOP), continuous glucose sensors (Dexcom G7, FreeStyle Libre), blood pressure monitors (Omron, Withings BPM), smart scales (Withings Body+), and home sleep systems (Eight Sleep). You authorize each brand yourself, and only the metrics you approve sync — on the schedule you choose, near real-time where the brand supports it. Interpreted trends feed your reports and let Health Guide explain patterns in plain language; raw sensor streams are not stored.

analysis.title: Multi-Model Analysis
analysis.desc: Two AI perspectives run in parallel

ai.exampleBody: Balanced energy with mild recovery load. Sleep quality improved 12% week over week.
ai.modelABody: Sleep debt and HRV dip suggest a 48-hour recovery window.
ai.modelBBody: Late meals and schedule shifts correlate with energy dips.
ai.unifiedBody: Prioritize sleep consistency and a lighter training day for 2 sessions.
ai.howToRead: How to read multi-model reports: compare Model A and Model B for complementary angles, then use the Unified Summary as your single source of action.

philosophy.title: Our Educational Philosophy
philosophy.body: The Learning Center educates through reassurance, not overload. We bridge the gap between data and daily choices. There are no lectures — only clarity. Our tone is calm, science-backed, human, and non-medical.
